notes.title: New update with ability to redefine keys and more
notes.notes:
We are pleased to announce a new update with the following features:-

    You can now redfine the key controls.
    Default (A,W,S,D) and classic (Q,A,O,P) Spectrum key options are available.
    Fast movement mode has been added.
    Navigate menu options with cursor keys and space or enter to select.  No need for the mouse if you want to stay retro.
    2 new graphics options.  Anti aliasing and texture filtering.  Select them in the settings menu.  Please note, results vary.  Texture filtering will give smoother looking graphics.
    See the manual for further information.  Includes a FAQ section.
